m62:
To find the smallest positive real number $C$ for which $\left\| \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 3 \\ 0 & -2 \end{pmatrix} \bold{v} \right\| \le C \|\bold{v}\|$ for all two-dimensional vectors $\mathbf{v}.$
